Pete Hegseth's recent announcement of testosterone screening for U.S. troops
channeled Colin Jost's cartoonish depiction of the Defense Secretary on
'Saturday Night Live.'

But the pathological version of masculinity Jost mocks extends far beyond
Hegseth. It permeates the entire MAGA movement, from Donald Trump on down.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

And as events this summer have shown, it's ugly, not funny.

As Hegseth [unveiled](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/trump-
administration/pete-hegseth-says-military-will-test-service-members-
testosterone-leve-rcna587682) his testosterone program, the _New York Times_
[reported](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/14/us/hegseth-blocks-navy-
promotions.html) that he blocked promotions for five senior Navy officers who
are women or people of color, including the first American woman to command a
nuclear aircraft carrier.
